intro: Syrian culture is famous for its old cities, crafts, music and some of the best food in the Middle East.

chapters.title: Crafts and heritage
text: Damascus steel, brocade cloth and Aleppo soap made from olive and laurel oil are historic crafts. Six Syrian sites are on the World Heritage list, though several were badly damaged in the war.

chapters.title: Food
text: Aleppo is famous for its kebabs and its peppers. Muhammara, kibbeh, fattoush and sweets like baklava are loved across the region.
